highlights: Recipes: keep a recipe with a link or your own notes, what goes in, the ferment jar and the bottle, and how long it lasts and where.
Give recipes a type — sauces, salsas, pestos, jams and more — or make your own.
Save any batch as a recipe, start one with Make this, or log I made this; a jar put up from a recipe gets the recipe's discard date when it's stored where the recipe says.
